eligibility_failure: The source file enumerates short peptide-HLA candidates derived from screened mutations. Most candidate short peptides were not individually assayed, so their rows cannot be treated as experimental pMHC negatives.
objective: Test whether the main same-task ordering and patient-level retrieval conclusions persist in a second patient-grouped experimental domain while expanding the public immunogenicity-model set.

dataset.name: NCI Surgery Branch mutated minimal peptide test set
dataset.endpoint: NCI Surgery Branch TIL reactivity screen of mutated minimal peptides
inclusion: MHC class I peptide-HLA row with a source patient ID
explicit experimentally screened positive or negative status
peptide sequence and four-digit HLA resolvable without fuzzy substitution
exclusion: unscreened, blank, dash, or otherwise unknown response
missing or ambiguous patient or HLA identity

primary_estimand.patient_denominator: source patients retaining at least one positive record on common model support
primary_estimand.model_support: intersection of valid predicted rows for the same-task immunogenicity predictors being paired
primary_estimand.comparison: all estimable paired same-task differences; no universal winner claim
primary_estimand.tie_rule: analytic expectation over all permutations at a score-tie boundary

leakage_policy.exact_peptide_hla: exclude the union of known exact training overlaps for the compared predictors
leakage_policy.near_sequence: report same-HLA same-length Hamming-distance-one sensitivity when training sequences are available
leakage_policy.unknown_training_data: retain an explicit unknown label; do not infer absence
leakage_policy.deepimmuno: audit against the public upstream training table
leakage_policy.prime_bigmhc: audit against official PRIME2 Table S4 and the published BigMHC immunogenicity construction
leakage_policy.deephlapan: mark unavailable training identities as unknown unless an official manifest is recovered

stopping_rules: A stable scientifically material incompatibility is recorded rather than silently patched or substituted.
A new model may be excluded from a comparison for task mismatch, known leakage, unsupported HLA or reproducible runtime failure.
Failure of one new predictor does not invalidate the external-dataset extension if at least the two existing same-task predictors run on qualified patient data.
No endpoint or primary metric changes after external predictions are inspected.
